title: Collatz matrix obstructions, synchronization, and basin densities: three papers and Lean artifacts
description:
Three standalone papers with LaTeX sources, PDFs, Lean proof sources, and fresh verification reports: (1) Two-coordinate obstructions for affine interpretations of the Yolcu–Aaronson–Heule Collatz system; (2) An independent second proof of Said Duran’s equal-height Collatz runs theorem; (3) Collatz basin densities and canonical traces from first-passage stabilization.

The matrix and synchronization scope has 137 checked Lean modules and 633 public theorem/lemma declarations. The basin scope checks selected steps in 35 modules, with 251 public theorem/lemma declarations and 55 audited definitions, including the complete abstract two-scale averaging lemma, uniform trajectory packing, correction products, and finite Syracuse residue laws. A separate source replay checks the real first-passage rate theorem at alpha=2001/2000; the original alpha=1001/1000 theorem and natural-density transport root passed a fresh 578-module rebuild. The downstream density and Green/cylinder identifications are not yet fully formalized. Priority for the equal-height existence theorem belongs to Omar Javier Said Duran. None of these papers proves the Collatz conjecture.

This DOI archives the complete repository release, containing the three individually titled papers.
